description: The DEX parameters a $BOBAI trade needs, read from the chain: PancakeSwap V2 router, pair, both swap paths, and the fee-on-transfer settings (3% tax, the slippage it needs — about 6% for a ~$100 trade, from the measured tax — and the SupportingFeeOnTransferTokens method names). Reports the numbers; a naive swap reverts without them. Use it before writing your own swap code; for ready-made code use bobai_purchase_guide.
name: bobai_dex_info
